page: Microsoft Azure NC96ads_A100_v4 is a GPU-accelerated server belonging to the NCADSA100v4 family. It features 96 dedicated physical cores powered by AMD EPYC 7V13 processors running at 3.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 880.0 GB of system memory, providing 9.17 GB per core. For acceleration, it bundles four NVIDIA Ampere A100 GPUs with a total of 320 GB VRAM, alongside 4102 GB of local NVMe SSD storage.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in multi-core processing and memory bandwidth. The server achieves top-tier status in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, PassMark CPU scores, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Single-core performance is moderate, with Geekbench single-core and single-threaded compression tests placing in the average tier. GPU-driven workloads show top-tier results, specifically in ray tracing and large-scale LLM inference, where prompt processing and text generation for 7B and 70B models consistently rank in the top 10%.

Given the high density of hardware resources, including dedicated AMD EPYC cores, massive NVMe SSD capacity, and quad A100 GPUs, this server represents a high-capital hardware class. It is designed for resource-intensive workloads where the cost of multi-GPU and high-memory configurations is offset by parallel execution speeds. Tradeoffs include average single-threaded performance relative to its massive multi-threaded capabilities. This server is suited for large-scale LLM inference, deep learning training, ray tracing, database operations, and complex multi-threaded scientific simulations.
